title: Senior Smart Contract Engineer (US / Latam)
description: The Mission Help build and scale the secure on-chain infrastructure powering the next generation of open finance. In this role, you’ll design, implement, and battle-test critical smart contracts that manage significant TVL and capital-efficient primitives. This isn't about deploying speculative tokens; it’s about constructing highly resilient, mathematical, and adversarial-resistant software that remains upgradeable, cost-efficient, and bulletproof over time. The Role As a core protocol contributor, you will take deep ownership of smart contract architecture from initial mathematical modeling and design through to mainnet deployment, external audit facilitation, and live monitoring. Protocol Architecture (40%): Design and implement secure, gas-optimized Solidity smart contracts for lending, borrowing, vaults, yield routing, liquidations, and access control. Testing & Simulation (30%): Write extensive unit, integration, fork, fuzz, and invariant tests utilizing modern frameworks to ensure zero-day resiliency. Security & Audits (15%): Prepare codebases for top-tier external audits, remediate findings, and design proactive on-chain risk mitigation/monitoring strategies. Cross-Functional Integration (15%): Collaborate closely with risk, frontend, indexer, and quantitative engineering teams to build seamless, secure end-to-end dApps. The Must-Haves Experience: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2+ years writing, deploying and maintaining highly secure Solidity smart contracts in production. Tooling & Frameworks: Expert-level mastery of Foundry (Forge, Cast) including advanced fuzzing, invariant testing, and mainnet fork simulations. EVM Deep Dive: Thorough understanding of EVM internals, storage layouts, gas optimization strategies, assembly (Yul), and standard proxy/upgradeability patterns. DeFi Primitives: Practical, working knowledge of core financial primitives (such as ERC-20/4626/721/1155, AMMs, lending pools, oracles, and liquidation engines). AI-Assisted Acceleration: Comfort using modern AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate unit testing, documentation, and boilerplate development, backed by the critical judgment required never to trust raw model outputs blindly. Security Mindset: An obsessive awareness of common attack vectors (reentrancy, oracle manipulation, front-running, rounding errors, and access-control flaws). The Bonus Skills Audit Pedigree: Prior experience guiding a protocol through a major external audit (e.g., Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, Spearbit) or participating in competitive security audits. Multi-Chain/SVM: Exposure to Rust-based smart contract environments (SVM/Solana, CosmWasm) or zero-knowledge (ZK) rollup architectures. Advanced Automation: Familiarity with off-chain automation infrastructure like Keepers, Defender, or Gelato. Personal Traits Adversarial Thinker: You don't just think about how code should work; you instinctively try to find ways to break, front-run, or exploit the state machine you are building. Execution & Ownership: You act as an owner, not a ticket executor. You proactively trace edge cases, optimize gas, and address technical debt before it is flagged. Detail-Obsessed: You care about the nuance of a single uint256 math operation and understand why rounding down vs. up is a security-critical decision. Collaborative & Clear: You can distill complex cryptographic or financial system logic into clear documentation and explain architectural tradeoffs to non-smart contract engineers. Location: Remote (with meaningful overlap with US/EU working hours)

Demonstrated ability to design systems, not just contracts — including tooling, automation, security across the contract lifecycle, and the integration points between contracts, applications, and operational teams. Proven results building and scaling a DeFi protocol. Python and/or TypeScript experience preferred (for building tooling and automation). Strong technical grasp and excellent judgment on task prioritization. Strong emphasis on understanding the "why" behind requirements and a commitment to defining the "minimum scope." Systems Engineering & Integrations: Design, build, and maintain production-grade Kubernetes operators, controllers, and internal platform APIs in Go. Infrastructure & Networking Delivery: Lead the design of cloud networking, DNS strategies, and cross-account connectivity across hybrid environments, automating VPC topology and dynamic network routing. Write RFCs, drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and establish high-confidence CI/CD pipelines, testing strategies, and GitHub Actions automation. Access & Security Strategy: Own the platform's authorization model, designing hierarchical RBAC systems, resource identifier schemes, and identity integrations that enforce fine-grained access control. VDI Integration: Oversee the integration of remote desktop/VDI connectivity solutions, focusing on session authentication, credential management, and gateway routing. Qualifications Experience: 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production infrastructure and cloud-native platforms at enterprise scale. Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Go (systems-level programming, API servers) and deep experience building Kubernetes controllers/operators using patterns like controller-runtime and kubebuilder. Kubernetes Internals: Expert-level knowledge of the Kubernetes ecosystem, including CRD/XRD generation, operators, informers, admission webhooks, and RBAC. Crossplane & Control Planes: Deep production experience with Crossplane, including composite resources, composition functions, and specifically developing custom Crossplane providers in Go to integrate external enterprise platforms. AWS & Networking: Extensive production experience with AWS multi-account architectures, cross-account networking patterns, and identity federation. Observability: Strong background in designing telemetry platforms using Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir, Loki, OpenTelemetry, and metrics collection agents (Alloy, Prometheus Node Exporter). Databases: Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQLite or similar relational databases, encompassing schema design, migrations, and query optimization. Communication: Excellent problem-solving skills with a proven ability to present architectural decisions to executives, engage with vendors, and write clear technical documentation. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Familiarity with broadcast/media production workflows and the strict operational constraints of live production environments.
